text:
marta_ops: Heads up — NexaSupply emailed a schedule change for the EU H100 tranche. New consolidated ETA window shifted to 2026-04-15 → 2026-04-20. They can air-priority a partial set or ship full sea. Also flagged RMA label workflow unclear and suggested DOA tolerance. Need quick decision on split + duties.
leo_procurement: Can we accept partial air? Cost delta roughly +$1.2k/unit for air. PO 88322 will need amendment if we go ahead.
anika_logistics: If we split, customs will want serials + manifest before pickup. Forwarder insists duties be prepaid for air to avoid hold. Otherwise expect 48–72h delay at clearance.
tara_finance: Finance can sign off on prepaid duties for an expedite batch up to EUR 50k under GL "logistics.expedite". Need final air qty and confirmed per-unit uplift.
sophie_sre: Operational caveat — eu-west clusters need the new driver package (runtimedrv v3.4) before onboarding H100s. Staging nodes must be prepatched or we'll have longer burn-in.
devin_oncall: Note: cluster autoscaler behavior if only partial arrives — we'll hit pod pending if we assume full capacity. Recommend we mark 10 units as "priority-air" so scheduling reflects reality.
vendor_fwd_bot: NexaSupply update: can allocate 12 units for air dispatch (H100, 700W config) with ETA to AMS 2026-04-12 local morning; remaining 28 by sea with ETA 2026-04-25. DOA historical rate 1.2%. RMA labels can be pre-generated but need depot confirmation for return routing.
marta_ops: Depot confirmation: EUDEPOT-3 (Amsterdam, Lena contact) is our preferred depot. We'll accept 12 air units to EUDEPOT-3. Can vendor provide serial-level manifest csv 24h before handoff?
anika_logistics: Manifest CSV required with headers exactly: serial,model,qty,declared_value. Also need dims/weights for AWB booking. Vendor: please attach.
leo_procurement: I'll raise PO amendment 88322-A to permit air for 12 units and DDP terms if vendor confirms. @nexasupply_rep can you confirm DDP vs DAP pricing delta?
nexasupply_rep: We can offer DDP for the air batch at +€1,100/unit. Sea batch remains DAP default. Air booking contingent on customs docs + commercial invoice sent 48h prior.
tara_finance: DDP for the air batch approved. Please cap uplift to EUR 50k line item — I need exact total to post GL adjustment.
sophie_sre: I'll schedule a preflight window for firmware/drivers: Mon 2026-04-13 09:00 CET. Need 4 staging nodes ready; ops, can you tag nodes as "air-priority" so our rollout scripts pick them up?
devin_oncall: On it — will add runbook note and a temp node tag. Also adding alert to #eng-runtime for any provisioning failures.
vendor_fwd_bot: Booking confirmation: AWB 123-ABC-789 created for 12 units. Flight ETA AMS 2026-04-12 08:00 CET. Carrier: QuickAir Freight. ETA to depot after customs ~ 04/12 17:00 CET. Manifest and scanned serials upload planned 04/11 10:00 CET.
marta_ops: Checklist copy into thread: 
- [ ] manifest with serials (vendor) 
- [ ] AWB and dims/weights (vendor) 
- [ ] RMA labels generated and sent to depot 
- [ ] finance amendment signed 
- [ ] staging nodes patched and tagged 
- [ ] DOA photo evidence SOP confirmed with depot
anika_logistics: For RMA labels: Depot needs return_address id EUDEPOT-3 + contact phone + email. We should set RMA SLA 7 days for DOA pickup. Vendor, can you confirm label format (PDF vs thermal) and include return-cost chargeback terms?
nexasupply_rep: We will provide PDF RMA labels (A4) by default. For thermal labels at depot we'd need to coordinate pre-printing; chargeback for DOA returns standard — credit back within 30 days after depot QC unless damage evidence found.
tara_finance: Acceptable. If DOA rate exceeds 1.5% across the tranche we escalate for partial refund. Please tag finance when manifest lands so I can run preliminary liability calc.
leo_procurement: PO amendment 88322-A created and pending @tara_finance approval for the DDP air uplift. I'll attach expected cost table and per-unit uplift in the doc.
tara_finance: Approved and signed. Uploading approval note to the PO. txn_ref: FIN-2026-042.
marta_ops: Thanks. Once manifest arrives, I'll push deployer to reserve slots and coordinate with @sophie_sre for firmware push.
sophie_sre: Copy. I'll prepare a small smoke test (nvtop + microbench) to run on arrival and want photo evidence of unit serial + crate for the inventory log.
devin_oncall: Minor ops request: add temporary quota increase of 16 GPUs to eu-west pool until sea batch lands. Ops, please open infra change ticket.
anika_logistics: Also request vendor send palletization spec + pallet IDs. Customs will want HS code and declared value for each pallet.
nexasupply_rep: Will send manifest CSV + palletization spec by 2026-04-11 10:00 CET. AWB already shared.
marta_ops: Great — owners: leo (PO), anika (logistics), tara (finance), sophie (SRE preflight), devin (oncall runbook). I'll follow up 04/11 after manifest upload. :thumbsup:
leo_procurement: on it.
anika_logistics: ack.
tara_finance: ack.
sophie_sre: ack.
devin_oncall: ack — will draft runbook snippet.
vendor_fwd_bot: Final note: sea batch ETA and booking details will follow after air pickup. We'll include RMA label zip in the manifest upload.
